methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Southwest and Southside Virginia’s advanced manufacturing tech hub to receive about $25 million in federal supplemental disaster funding meant for economic development
signals.signal_reading: Federal investment in advanced manufacturing tech hub for historically underserved regions signals intentional distribution of technical capability beyond traditional metros, though success depends on whether training creates deep AI fluency or shallow tool adoption among 60,000 workers.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents grassroots institutional capacity-building outside metro centers, creating leadership training infrastructure that could enable peer-to-peer knowledge networks rather than platform dependence—a classic 'deep & distributed' signal if it scales beyond single institution.

signals.title: Norfolk uses artificial intelligence to handle thousands of non-emergency calls - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk's AI deployment for non-emergency calls demonstrates distributed geographic adoption but shallow engagement—government purchasing turnkey platforms rather than building internal AI capability, signaling broad but surface-level adoption across Virginia's military-industrial region.

signals.title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia — site to be repurposed for mixed-use and residential development. - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: Amazon canceling four NoVA data centers amid local backlash reveals infrastructure resistance even in Virginia's most AI-ready region, potentially constraining the state's computational capacity growth and signaling political barriers to both concentration and distribution pathways.

signals.title: Sentara hospitals are using AI to help monitor patients, determine discharge timelines
signals.signal_reading: Sentara's AI deployment for patient monitoring concentrates advanced healthcare capability in established medical systems with capital and expertise, deepening institutional AI sophistication while leaving smaller rural providers further behind in care quality and operational efficiency.
